description.narrative:
In its five-year strategic plan, covering the period 2020-2024, IFEX has identified four key priority areas:
1) Right to information - Goal: The challenges of access to information, its circulation and integrity, are confronted. Objectives: 1. Increased adoption and implementation of robust access to information (ATI) laws and standards by states. 2. Circulation of information online and offline better promoted and defended. 3. Greater action to counter the threats to information integrity online and offline and their impact on Freedom of Expression and Information (FoE&I). 2) Civic Space - Goal: Civil society enabled and civic space protected as it relates to FoE&I. Objectives: 1. Increased network push back against efforts and issues that diminish and/or restrict civic space as it relates to FoE&I. 2. Value of civic space as it relates to FoE&I is acknowledged and reinforced among IFEX's target audience of members, allies, and other engaged individuals and actors. 3) Safety & Justice - Goal: A safer environment for those exercising their right to FoE&I. Objectives: 1. Strengthened normative environment and protection practices for the safety of those exercising their right to FoE&I. 2. Improved justice for those experiencing FoE&I violations. 4) Network building - Goal: Strengthened capacity of the IFEX network to promote and defend the right to FoE&I. Objectives: 1. Enhance member organisational capacity. 2. Enhance meaningful connections between IFEX members. 3. Connections with allies outside the IFEX network are strengthened and diversified.

IFEX is a global network of more than 100 organisations in over 70 countries around the world, dedicated to defend and promote freedom of expression and information as a fundamental human right.
IFEX has developed a new five-year strategy for the period 2020-2024. The strategy focuses on four thematic areas, each of them with an overall goal: 1) Right to information - The challenges of access to information, its circulation and integrity, are confronted. 2) Civic Space - Civil society enabled and civic space protected as it relates to Freedom of Expression and Information (FoE&I). 3) Safety and Justice - A safer environment for those exercising their right to FoE&I. 4) Network building - Strengthened capacity of the IFEX network to promote and defend the right to FoE&I.

Insatsen avser ett kärnstöd till yttrandefrihetsnätverket IFEX om totalt 60 MSEK under en femårsperiod 2020-2024. För denna period har IFEX utvecklat en strategi, med fokus på fyra tematiska områden:
1) "Right to information" - med målsättningen att addressera de olika utmaningar som finns kring rätten och tillgång till information.
2) "Civic space" - med målsättningen att de som försvarar yttrandefrihet och rätten till information och de utrymmen som finns stärks och skyddas.
3) "Safety and justice" - med målsättningen att skapa en säkrare miljö för de som utövar sin rätt till yttrandefrihet och information.
4) "Network building" - stärkt kapacitet inom IFEX-nätverket att främja och försvara rätten till yttrandefrihet och information.

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative:
IFEX has achieved or exceeded its expected results in thematic areas related to freedom of information, civic space, and safety. The following was captured during the evaluation process:
IFEX has effectively integrated digital freedom of expression issues into its programming and operations.
89% of members agreed that IFEX has successfully confronted challenges to access to information.
94% of members reported that IFEX contributed to enabling civil society and protecting civic space.
86% of members felt that IFEX has contributed to a safer environment for those exercising their right to freedom of expression.
Progress on Equity and Inclusion
IFEX has made significant strides in integrating equity and inclusion across its initiatives.
85% of respondents agreed that IFEX has meaningfully integrated equity and inclusion into its work. Members highlighted the importance of diverse voices in events and discussions. Specific initiatives included support for diversity policies in Argentina and assistance for Nicaraguan journalists in Costa Rica. Suggestions for improvement included greater emphasis on diversity in leadership and support for members' equity initiatives.
Digital Freedom of Expression Initiatives
86% of survey respondents agreed that IFEX has meaningfully addressed digital FoE issues. Members praised IFEX's support for digital security training and initiatives addressing misinformation. Examples of successful digital initiatives include collaboration with Palestinian organizations to combat online incitement and support for Malaysian CSOs in managing digital threats. Members called for increased focus on emerging technologies, including AI.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
